sources.entry: string.is - Online string toolkit for developers. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs

summary.one_liner: string.is is an open-source, privacy-friendly online toolkit that auto-detects the format of pasted input and converts it between developer formats.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes string.is as an opinionated conversion tool for developers. It tries to detect the format of the input (identifiers return a confidence score for formats such as JWT tokens) and then offers matching output options. Conversions are built from input parsers (for example JSON and CSV), output formatters (for example JavaScript and JSON), and converter pairs that connect them. It sets no cookies and uses a strict Content Security Policy. The README says it is localized under locales/ with English as the only locale provided. Optional Plausible Analytics can be enabled through an environment variable.
use_cases: decode and inspect a JWT token
format or reformat JSON in the browser
convert data between developer formats privately
notable: Auto-detects input format using identifiers that return a confidence score
No cookies and a strict Content Security Policy
Conversion logic in pure TypeScript under src/lib, separate from React UI
Docker images for linux/arm64 and linux/amd64, with a sub-path deployment option via NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH
caveats: Static builds via next export are not supported because the i18n feature requires a server
